# Laser Cutting Process FAQ

<!-- This page is auto-generated from the field FAQ knowledge base, 8 entries -->

## Q1: Laser cutting, the laser does not emit light

1. Check whether the laser enable, the laser, and the water cooler are on 2. Check whether the laser is powered on

## Q2: During laser cutting calibration, upper and lower soft limit overrun is reported

1. Jog the U axis up and down on the PC interface and perform capacitance calibration again

## Q3: Laser cutting suddenly cannot cut through, with spark emission

1. Check whether the lens is dirty; if dirty, the lens needs to be replaced

## Q4: Laser cutting edge search failed

1. Check whether the maximum moving distance in the edge search settings is sufficient to reach the edge of the plate

## Q5: Laser cutting end point-around is inaccurate

1. Select the no-tool-hand state and perform 7-point calibration to recalibrate the tool hand 2. Use the calibration nozzle and calibration ball for RTCP calibration; during calibration, first perform capacitance calibration on the calibration ball, using the U axis follow jog to keep the distance from the end to the ball surface at 20mm

## Q6: Laser cutting reports gas pressure too high

1. Check whether the gas required for cutting is correct 2. Perform air pressure calibration and air pressure detection

## Q7: When running the laser cutting program, the laser head hits the plate

1. Perform capacitance calibration 2. Check whether the Z value of the user coordinate system is correct

## Q8: Laser cutting reports position unreachable

1. Check whether the zero point and origin position are correct 2. Check whether the limit is exceeded
